# Load libraries
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(sf)
library(randomForest)
library(ranger)
library(caret)
library(performance)
```

# Load data
```{r}
source("_config.r")

# Load preprocessed moss model data (slopes + climate features + static env, one row per plot)
moss_data <- readRDS(PATH_MDL3_SLOPES_MOSS)
```

# Data preparation
## Check dimensions, remove ID and slope_year column
```{r}
dim(moss_data) # 1445 x 30
View(moss_data)

moss_data <- moss_data |> select(-aID_STAO, -total_change_pct, -baseline_richness)

dim(moss_data) # 1377 x 27
```

# Species change modelling
## CV model using simple hyperparameter
```{r}
train_control <- caret::trainControl(
  method          = "repeatedcv",
  number          = 5,
  repeats         = 10,
  savePredictions = "all",
  returnResamp    = "all"
)

# Set best hyperparameters
best_mtry <- floor(sqrt(ncol(moss_data)))
best_min_node_size <- 3

# Fit CV model with best hyperparameters to get performance metrics across all folds/repeats
set.seed(123)
rf_moss_change_cv <- caret::train(
  richness_slope ~ .,
  data        = moss_data,
  method      = "ranger",
  num.trees   = 500,
  trControl   = train_control,
  tuneGrid    = expand.grid(
    mtry          = best_mtry,
    splitrule     = "variance",
    min.node.size = best_min_node_size
  ),
  na.action   = na.omit,
  num.threads = max(1, parallel::detectCores() - 1),
  verbose     = TRUE
)

rf_moss_change_cv

# Manual summary across all folds/repeats with standard parameters
resamp_std <- rf_moss_change_cv$resample
data.frame(
  metric = c("RMSE", "Rsquared", "MAE"),
  mean   = colMeans(resamp_std[, c("RMSE", "Rsquared", "MAE")], na.rm = TRUE),
  sd     = apply(resamp_std[, c("RMSE", "Rsquared", "MAE")], 2, sd, na.rm = TRUE)
)
#           metric       mean          sd
# RMSE         RMSE 0.30365987 0.019473718
# Rsquared Rsquared 0.02105203 0.013603134
# MAE           MAE 0.21280288 0.008145288

saveRDS(rf_moss_change_cv, file = file.path(DIR_MDL3_OUT, "moss_change/rf_moss_change_cv.rds"))
write.csv(rf_moss_change_cv$results, file = file.path(DIR_MDL3_OUT, "moss_change/rf_moss_change_cv_ranking.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```

# Fit final model using all data
```{r}
# Fit final model using all data with best hyperparameters
rf_moss_change_final <- ranger::ranger(
  formula     = richness_slope ~ .,
  data        = moss_data,
  num.trees   = 500,
  mtry        = best_mtry,
  min.node.size = best_min_node_size,
  importance   = "permutation",
  num.threads = max(1, parallel::detectCores() - 1),
  write.forest = TRUE,
  oob.error   = TRUE,
  verbose     = TRUE,
  seed        = 123
)

rf_moss_change_final
# OOB prediction error (MSE):       0.09278523 
# R squared (OOB):                  0.008097786  

# Save final model
saveRDS(rf_moss_change_final, file = file.path(DIR_MDL3_OUT, "moss_change/rf_moss_change_final_model.rds"))
```

## Variable importance
```{r}
# Extract variable importance p-values via Altmann permutation test
set.seed(123)
imp_pvals <- ranger::importance_pvalues(
  rf_moss_change_final,
  method            = "altmann",
  formula           = richness_slope ~ .,
  data              = moss_data,
  num.permutations  = 100,
  num.threads      = max(1, parallel::detectCores() - 1),
  verbose           = TRUE
)

var_importance <- as.data.frame(imp_pvals) |>
  tibble::rownames_to_column("variable") |>
  dplyr::arrange(pvalue)

var_importance

# Save variable importance
write.csv(var_importance, file = file.path(DIR_MDL3_OUT, "moss_change/rf_moss_change_variable_importance.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```
